title: 第23章 艺术来源于生活第24章出手相救
slug: 脸盲宗主她又抓错人了
content_zh:
解决了两个人渣，感觉世间空气都清新了几分的白露，缓缓走出幽暗的小巷。
明媚的阳光骤然洒落，让她轻纱遮掩下的清澈凤眸下意识地微微眯起。
与此同时，一股清甜的香气钻入鼻尖，紧接着是街道两旁各种食物混杂的诱人飘香。
这立刻让白露的眼睛亮了起来。
她循着香气，径直走向巷口那些小摊贩，兴致勃勃地开始挨个购买。
幸好储物空间里还存着之前带灵族兄妹回来时，途中兑换的碎银和小金锭。
足够支撑她在凡间的所有开销。
仅仅逛了四五个小吃摊和旁边几家糕点铺子，双手就已满满当当。
她的双手就满满当当了。
看着手中的那些小吃，白露准备找一个没人的地方，将这些都塞进储物空间后。
再继续出来买买买。
可就在她经过前方巷口一个卖首饰的小摊时，目光却被摊位上摆放的一支银簪牢牢吸引住了。
那是一支极其精致的蝴蝶银簪，蝶翼呈现出柔和的银粉色，下方垂坠着长短不一的细链。
链子上还点缀着细小的闪光碎晶，在阳光下熠熠生辉，极为吸睛。
就在白露思考着要不要将手中那些体量较小的东西，悄摸摸的收进储物空间时。
她面前就突然伸出了一只涂着豆蔻的纤纤玉手，抢先一步拿走了那支银簪。
同时，一道娇媚入骨的声音在她耳边响起：“裴郎，你看这枚银簪多漂亮呀，不如买给奴家吧？”
白露下意识地循声看去。
只见一位身着嫣红色水袖宫裙、容貌娇艳的女子。
正依偎在一个身穿湖蓝色锦袍的年轻男子怀中，举着那支银簪撒娇。

看着对方纤纤玉手中拿着的那枚银簪。
白露只好心中感叹时运不济，于是暗自摇了摇头，便准备转身离开。
结果就在她转身离开之际。
一把被打开的白色扇子却突然拦在了面前。
一道带着几分轻佻显得吊儿郎当的声音响起：“这位小娘子，瞧着好生面生啊？”
“不知是武阳城中哪位大人府上的千金，在下怎的从未见过？”
白露：？？
这狗血的剧情终于落到自己的头上了吗？
这难道是每个穿越者都会被迫经历的剧情？
“在下裴初晟，敢问小娘子芳名。”
自称裴初晟的男子松开怀中的美娇娘，收回折扇。
content_en:
After dealing with the two scumbags, Bai Lu felt that the air in the world was a little fresher, and slowly walked out of the dark alley.
The bright sunshine suddenly fell, causing her clear phoenix eyes covered by the gauze to subconsciously narrow slightly.
At the same time, a sweet aroma penetrated the tip of the nose, followed by the tempting aroma of various foods on both sides of the street.
This immediately made Bai Lu's eyes light up.
Following the scent, she went straight to the small vendors at the alley and started buying one by one with great interest.
Fortunately, there are still pieces of silver and small gold ingots exchanged on the way back when I brought the Eldar brothers and sisters back in the storage space.
Enough to support all her expenses in the mortal world.
After just visiting four or five food stalls and a few pastry shops nearby, my hands were full.
Her hands were full.
Looking at the snacks in her hands, Bai Lu prepared to find a place where no one was around and stuff them into the storage space.
Continue to come out and buy, buy, buy.
But just as she passed a stall selling jewelry in the alley ahead, her eyes were firmly attracted by a silver hairpin placed on the stall.
It was an extremely delicate silver butterfly hairpin. The butterfly wings showed a soft silvery pink color, and thin chains of different lengths hung from the bottom.
The chain is also dotted with tiny sparkling crystals, which sparkle in the sunlight and are extremely eye-catching.
Just when Bai Lu was thinking about whether to quietly put the smaller things in his hands into the storage space.
Suddenly a slender jade hand coated with cardamom stretched out in front of her and took away the silver hairpin first.
At the same time, a charming voice sounded in her ears: "Pei Lang, look at how beautiful this silver hairpin is, why not buy it for the slave family?"
Bai Lu followed the sound subconsciously.
I saw a beautiful woman wearing a bright red palace dress with water sleeves.
She was nestling in the arms of a young man wearing a lake blue brocade robe, holding up the silver hairpin coquettishly.
Look at the silver hairpin held in the other person's delicate hand.
Bai Lu could only lament the bad luck in her heart, so she shook her head secretly and prepared to turn around and leave.
As a result, she turned around and left.
An opened white fan suddenly stopped in front of him.
A somewhat frivolous and carefree voice sounded: "This little lady, does she look so unfamiliar?"
"I wonder if she is the daughter of some lord in Wuyang City. How come I have never seen her before?"
Bai Lu:? ?
Has this bloody plot finally happened to him?
Is this a plot that every time traveler will be forced to experience?
"My dear, Pei Chusheng, may I ask the young lady her name."
The man who called himself Pei Chusheng let go of the beautiful girl in his arms and took back the folding fan.
